validator: independent Validator subagent (not the executing session that produced the study), 2026-10-22

replay_binary.note: identical to binary_sha256 in every one of the 308,511 records, so a replay re-executes the recorded method code; ecbench replays compare recovered scalar, total and per-phase GAE, phase counts, counters, factor base, field operations and unpriced/determinism fields exactly

sampling.drawn: from /dev/urandom by the validator before any replay ran
sampling.rule: (1) forced: the 4 largest main sessions by uncompressed records.jsonl bytes; (2) forced: the interrupted session l2-s1002/spec with --allow-interrupted; (3) for each ell in {2,3} and each session type {main, spec-aa, spec-bsgs, spec-icctl}, the 2 not-yet-selected classes with the smallest sha256(nonce:ell:type:class); N per session = 17 + (sha256(nonce:N:session)[0:4] mod 24), +1 if N is a multiple of 12. ecbench --replay N replays the runs at indices floor(j*len/N) of the measured verified deterministic runs, so N != 12 makes the sample differ from the producer's audits (--replay 12) except index 0.

manifest_check.method: every sessions/MANIFEST.sha256 entry hashed from the committed plain file or from the decompressed .gz stream (all 113 sessions); each replayed session was additionally decompressed to a scratch copy and its 5 files re-checked against the manifest before ecbench verify ran on the copy (copies deleted afterwards)

independent_scalar_check.implementation: validation/vrecompute.rs (validator's own affine short-Weierstrass arithmetic over F_p; no ecbench code)
independent_scalar_check.checked: for every record (308,511, including warm-ups and the interrupted session): Q on the curve, [k]G == Q for the recorded recovered k, k == planted mod r; per curve-model: p and r prime, r | #E, [r]G = O, [#E]G = O, Hasse bound, nonsingular, a != 0 and b != 0 (j != 0, 1728), j equal to the sidecar's
nonverified_records: l2-s1002/spec seq 190 arm ic-mitm warmup true status crashed

totals.interrupted_session_note: l2-s1002/spec holds 191 warm-up records only (95 rho-neg, 95 ic-mitm verified, 1 ic-mitm crashed at the interruption) and no measured run, so ecbench has 0 runs to replay there; its integrity checks pass with --allow-interrupted and the validator's own scalar check covers its 190 verified records
